text:
Liam (PM): Quick sync — Smart Suggest v1 launched last week. Seeing a few bug reports + a pile of small enhancement asks. Proposal: prioritize P0 regressions immediately, then a QOL bundle for low-risk fixes next sprint. Thoughts? @sam_eng @asha_qa @kevin_cs

Sam (Eng): Agree with priority. Can you drop the triage list? I can do a patch release for P0s. For enhancements let’s batch by risk and owner.

Kevin (CS): Customer impact summary: 3 customers reported suggestion duplication (high severity), 7 customers flagged truncation behavior being too aggressive (medium). Several asked for copy tweaks.

Asha (QA): I reproduced the duplication in staging with seed 42. Steps to reproduce in staging: create doc -> query "smart suggest" -> observe duplicate items at positions 2/3. Logs show repeated candidate IDs.```
seed=42\nrequest_id=stg-93a\ntrace: suggest.candidate.emit x2
```

Zoe (Design): Small UX tweak request: change CTA from "See more" to "Refine suggestions" — low risk copy update.

Liam (PM): Proposed plan: (1) Patch release for duplication (P0) this week. (2) QOL bundle next sprint for copy + truncation tweak. (3) Anything that requires model retrain gets labeled enhancement/model and deprioritized for now. Any objections?

Sam (Eng): No objections. Need an owner for the duplication fix and an automated regression test. Suggest assigning @Alex (Eng). Also don't mix model-impacting changes in the hotfix.

Alex (Eng): I'll take ownership. Creating branch `hotfix/duplication-1777`. ETA EOD Thu. Will add integration test and emit telemetry event `suggestion.duplicate`.

Asha (QA): I'll write the regression and smoke tests and validate on staging. Recommend we run smoke tests against the top 5 customer tenants before prod.

Kevin (CS): :thumbsup: I'll notify the affected customers with a temporary workaround (enable dedupe flag in tenant settings) while we push the hotfix.

Liam (PM): Agreed label set for triage — please apply when filing issues:```
labels:\n- priority:P0\n- type:bug\n- area:inference\n- triage:postlaunch
```

Zoe (Design): I'd prefer to keep copy change out of hotfix and include it in the QOL bundle so we can A/B test the language.

Sam (Eng): +1 to not mixing anything that could touch scoring in the hotfix. Keep it strictly duplication fix + tests.

Liam (PM): Decision: Hotfix = duplication P0 only. QOL bundle next sprint = copy + truncation tweak + minor UX fixes. I'll update the roadmap and create two short PRDs (hotfix PRD + QOL RFC). Moving grooming of the rest to the #product-grooming session tomorrow 10:00am.

Kevin (CS): Can we prioritize customer list for comms? Top three affected: AcmeCorp, Finly, HealthAI. I'll add details to the ticket and ping CSMs.

Alex (Eng): Branch pushed, CI green. Deploy window requested for tomorrow 02:00 UTC. Notifying oncall.

deploy-bot: Deploy created: hotfix/duplication-1777 -> staging. CI passed at 12:34 UTC.

Asha (QA): QA passed in staging, regression tests green. Ready for prod after release approval. Attached test checklist to the ticket.

Liam (PM): Thanks — next steps: Sam prepares release notes, Kevin drafts customer comms, Zoe prepares the QOL copy variant for the bundle. I'll update roadmap and follow up in grooming. If no blockers, we'll close this thread.

Sam (Eng): Noted and will prep release notes.

Kevin (CS): I'll send the customer comms draft by EOD.

Zoe (Design): Will drop copy variants in Figma and link in the QOL RFC.

Liam (PM): Closing for now — reopening if anything new comes up.
